title: Canonical DVR open restriction and extension interface
statement: Fix a prime and finite coefficient extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and a scheme open immersion on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. OpenDvrOpenModel records finite-constant-normalized and completed-projection-normalized open restriction of the completed integral coefficients [def-weil-derived-complete], actual scalar restriction equivalence, and the exact open-extension adjunction [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Its jShriek is the derived scalar equivalence followed by the exact derived extension. This is the existing open part of the former bundled model node, without any change to its data or normalization.
